sourceQuotes.zh: 梁祖之開國也，屬黃巢大亂之後。
sourceQuotes.literal: When the founding emperor of Liang established the state, it fell in the period after Huang Chao's great rebellion.
sourceQuotes.idiomatic: When the Liang founding emperor established his dynasty, the realm was still reeling from Huang Chao's great rebellion.

sourceQuotes.zh: 以夷門一鎮，外嚴烽侯，內辟汙萊，厲以耕桑，薄以租賦，士雖苦戰，民則樂輸，二紀之間，俄成霸業。
sourceQuotes.literal: With a single prefecture at Yimen, outwardly he tightened beacon and frontier defense, inwardly he opened wasteland and marshes, urged farming and sericulture, and kept rents and levies light; though the warriors suffered in battle, the people gladly paid taxes, and within two twenty-year cycles he swiftly achieved hegemony.
sourceQuotes.idiomatic: From the single stronghold of Yimen he tightened frontier defenses abroad and reclaimed wasteland at home, promoted farming and silk production, and kept rents and levies light. Soldiers bore the hardships of war, but the people paid their dues willingly; within two twenty-year cycles he had built a hegemonic power almost overnight.
